diagnostics.message: module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:output.access_key_id: explicit depends_on of module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:resource.aws_iam_access_key.this_user is redundant — already implied by attribute references
module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:output.access_secret_key: explicit depends_on of module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:resource.aws_iam_access_key.this_user is redundant — already implied by attribute references
certificate already depends on cert_manager transitively through cluster_issuer; the direct depends_on is redundant.
kiali already depends on kube_prometheus_stack_operator_crds through istiod, so this explicit dependency duplicates that ordering.
access_key_id references this_user.id and therefore already depends on the access key.
access_secret_key references this_user.secret and therefore already depends on the access key.
elk mounts elastic-certificates by literal name but has no ordering dependency on elasticsearch_certificates; create the secret before installing its consumers.

fix.expression: [for v in [local.elk_elasticsearch_values, local.elk_kibana_values, local.elk_filebeat_values, local.elk_apm_values, local.elk_metricbeat_values] : replace(v, "elastic-certificates", kubernetes_secret.elasticsearch_certificates[count.index].metadata[0].name)]
